name: Stash (Dev)
description: Dev channel build of Stash. Media organizer that scans, tags and catalogs a personal video collection with a web browser and API.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    command: "stash --postgres postgres://stash:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/stash?sslmode=disable"
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/root/.stash
      - {{appDataPath}}/media:/data
      - {{appDataPath}}/metadata:/metadata
      - {{appDataPath}}/cache:/cache
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: stash
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: stash
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
